villager_1.who: A young village woman in a simple ankle-length dress of faded blue with a cream apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, brown hair tied back in a short tail, brown shoes. Cheerful and ordinary — she is one of the townsfolk, not an adventurer.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at her sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly and let one hand rest on her hip
walk: mid-stride with her LEFT leg forward and her right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with her RIGHT leg forward and her left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

villager_2.who: A stocky village man in a loose russet-brown tunic belted at the waist, dark green trousers, sturdy boots, and a short beard under a flat brown cap. Friendly and weathered — a townsman, not a soldier.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly and folded his arms loosely
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

villager_3.who: An older village woman in a long moss-green skirt and a cream blouse with a rust-red shawl over her shoulders, grey hair in a bun, a simple headscarf. Kindly and unhurried — a townswoman.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, hands clasped in front of her
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly and let her hands fall to her sides
walk: mid-stride with her LEFT leg forward and her right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with her RIGHT leg forward and her left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
